name: Three-week look-ahead constraint review
summary: Before the coordination meeting, the superintendent gets a brief that sets each planned activity of the next three weeks beside what could hold it up: trades sharing an area, unfinished predecessors, open approvals, late deliveries and unanswered RFIs. The superintendent confirms the sequence and assigns the follow-up.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of construction site coordination, and its own rules for prepared work: the project's records as the only authority, every gap written as a question for the superintendent, and a person who confirms the sequence and assigns the follow-up.
